investment_theses.thesis: Long DXY (U.S. Dollar Index) through June 2026 as AI capex cycle and supply-chain cybersecurity costs inflate domestic import prices and force Fed to hold rates higher than consensus expects.
supporting_signals: Meta $25B debt raise + accelerating AI capex signals corporate capital flight to hard assets (dollar bonds > crypto)
Binance $6.3B hack + CrowdStrike AI kill-switch product launch normalize cybersecurity costs, raising enterprise USD cash needs
CFTC perpetual futures approval on stocks may cannibalize crypto liquidity, pushing institutional money toward traditional FX carry strategies in USD
investment_theses.counter_view: Democratic midterm wins could signal fiscal stimulus appetite, weakening dollar; alternatively, if UK/EU adopt offshore wind more aggressively (bullish Democrat narrative), euro strength could limit DXY upside.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY via DBC or FXI futures; hedge with long TLT (long-duration Treasuries) to capture duration upside if rate-hiking cycle extends.

supporting_signals: CoinDesk: 'CZ warns of more AI-driven hacks following Binance's historic $6.3 billion heist'; supply-chain AI compromise is new attack surface
South Korea's immediate legislative push post-Binance signals imminent CISO budget reallocations away from AI chips toward security

Hacker News: Postman silently auto-installing AI plugins + OpenAI re-enabling model training on Codex chats suggest AI tool supply chains are actively compromised; CISOs will demand vetting cycles before GPU deployment

investment_theses.thesis: Long XLE (Energy Select Sector) via overweight to offshore wind and solar names (TAN sector) on Democratic midterm narrative and renewable energy policy acceleration into 2027.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 'A Democratic Congress could be good for offshore wind and solar energy' (explicit policy tailwind if Dems hold House)
Prediction markets favor Democrats in key crypto races; crypto-friendly Democrats also favor green energy funding (capital reallocation from fossil fuels)
Offshore wind capex cycles extend into 2027; current market pricing assumes GOP midterm sweep, undervaluing renewable optionality
investment_theses.counter_view: If Republicans gain House seats, offshore wind policy grinds to halt; natural gas and oil could outperform. Energy prices remain commodity-dependent, independent of policy.
investment_theses.expression: Long TAN (Invesco Solar ETF) or ICLN (iClimate Global ETF) with 50% hedge via short XLE (Energy sector); unwind hedge if Republicans underperform midterm expectations after May 5.

investment_theses.thesis: Long BTC/ETH ratio into August 2026 as institutional adoption via spot ETFs and CFTC perpetual futures approval favors Bitcoin narrative (store-of-value, macro hedge) over Ethereum (execution risk tied to MEV, staking centralization, and AI oracle dependencies).
supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: 'Wall Street killed Bitcoin's wild rallies'; Bitcoin now priced as macro uncorrelated asset, Ethereum as altcoin beta
CoinDesk: 'CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks'; institutional derivatives infrastructure favors single-asset (BTC) positioning over multi-chain (ETH) complexity
Binance hack via compromised AI tool raises oracle/middleware attack surface risk; Ethereum ecosystem more exposed to this vector than Bitcoin settlement layer
investment_theses.counter_view: Ethereum Shanghai/Dencun upgrades unlock MEV-burn deflationary mechanics; staking yield and stablecoin adoption could revalue ETH faster than BTC narrative. Spot ETH ETF approval (if it happens by Sept 2026) could narrow ratio.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC/ETH ratio via perpetual futures on Bybit or Deribit; alternatively, long spot BTC + short spot ETH via exchange trading.

investment_theses.thesis: Short Disney (DIS) and long niche labor-intensive names (staffing, temp agencies) as Disney's layoff narrative spreads to media/entertainment sector, creating structured demand for contractor/outsource workers and wage deflation for permanent roles.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 'Disney plans several thousand layoffs, asks some managers to cut costs by up to 20%'; signal for sector-wide cost cuts in media
Meta, Amazon, other mega-cap tech also cutting; outsourcing and gig economy benefit from permanent-to-contractor shift
Energy policy uncertainty (2026 midterms) defers capex; labor demand shifts from construction/energy to flexible, short-term contractor roles
investment_theses.counter_view: Disney streaming profitability improvements could justify layoffs; content quality/subscriber metrics may offset margin concerns. Tech layoffs may end if AI productivity gains deliver ROI faster than expected.
investment_theses.expression: Short DIS via put spreads or underweight in media portfolio; hedge with long MAN (ManpowerGroup) or PAYX (Paychex) as indirect play on contractor workforce expansion.
